job_post_list.title: Project Management Office Associate Graduate (Finance) - 2027 Start (MBA)
job_post_list.description:
We partner closely with business leaders and cross-functional teams to turn financial insights into better business decisions. Leveraging our expertise in budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and performance analysis, we provide strategic guidance that helps teams prioritize investments, optimize resources, and drive sustainable growth.

Beyond delivering financial support, we strive to be trusted business partners—bringing commercial insight, challenging assumptions, and enabling informed decision-making to help the business achieve both its operational and financial objectives.
We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.
Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

About the Role
We are seeking a high-performing MBA graduate to join our Finance BP - Global Products and Functions as a Project Management Office Associate. This role offers a unique opportunity to work directly with the head of Finance BP team and senior finance leadership team, driving cross-functional initiatives, enabling strategic decision-making, and ensuring the effective execution of high-impact projects.

Responsibilities 
- Partner closely with the Finance leadership team to manage the execution of strategic priorities and cross-functional initiatives.
- Develop clear, compelling executive-level communications, presentations, and narratives to support decision-making and stakeholder engagement.
- Drive program governance, including tracking deliverables, timelines, and risks to ensure initiatives are executed with excellence.
- Collaborate across Finance, Business Units, and Corporate Functions to ensure alignment and delivery of strategic objectives.
- Synthesize complex financial and operational information into clear, actionable insights for senior executives and stakeholders.
- Support annual and quarterly business planning, financial reviews, and strategic updates.
- Collaborate with cross-functional leaders across Ads, E-commerce, Live, and TikTok FBP teams to execute key projects and develop deep functional expertise in underlying business models.
job_post_list.requirement:
Minimum Qualifications 
- Individuals who are completing or have recently completed an MBA Degree
- Solid finance background, with prior experience in investment banking, consulting, corporate finance, or related fields.
- Exceptional executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to distill complex topics into clear and impactful narratives.
- Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
- Collaborative mindset and ability to influence stakeholders across levels and functions.
- High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism in handling confidential information.
- Working proficiency in Mandarin and English is required as the role will be working with systems, reading technical documents and communicating with China and Non-China markets in Mandarin and English.

Preferred Qualifications: 
- Minimum of 3 years of industry experience.

job_post_list.title: Product Operations Intern (TikTok Shop Apps and API) - 2027 Summer (MBA)
job_post_list.description:
About the team
Our Partner Product team is responsible for our Open API Platform and TikTok Shop's App Ecosystem for 1P and 3P partners. This team focuses on products that will empower partners to collaborate with the platform together, providing rich and diverse service capabilities to help merchants and creators to operate more effectively and efficiently. We are looking for a product manager who will be responsible for collection of users’ requirements and partner product design to provide our target users/clients with effective product solutions.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.
Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities
- Conduct extensive quantitative and qualitative market studies to gather deep insights into Sellers, Independent Software Vendors (ISV) Partners and other roles in social content-based Commerce.  
- Partner with the product management team to devise product strategy to ensure long term vision and success for the product.
- Combine ROI analysis, dependency analysis and other techniques to prioritize the product requirements. 
- Participate in the product development lifecycle, review various artifacts to ensure quality.  
- Participate in user acceptance testing to ensure product quality and optimal user experience prior to product launch.
job_post_list.requirement:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Currently pursuing a MBA degree
- Able to commit to working for 12 weeks during Summer 2027.
- Great communicator & team-partner.  Comfortable navigating complex organizational structures & aligning objectives with cross-functional teams.
- Analytical, data sensitive & goal-driven.  Comfortable with setting ambitious targets, analyzing the status quo, planning a course of action, executing rapid trial & error iterations and constantly improving. 

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiar with TikTok and mainstream e-commerce platforms, experience in content-based e-commerce is highly preferred.
- Experience and understanding of APIs and 3P integrations.

job_post_list.title: US Commercial Infrastructure Management Graduate (Global Procurement) - 2027 Start (MBA)
job_post_list.description:
The procurement team undertake logistics-related service and physical procurement as well as service provider management work in line with the development of logistics business. Be responsible for the price competitiveness of procurement services while meeting business requirements, and maintain relationships with service providers to ensure long-term cooperation.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.
Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.
Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

1. Strategic Sourcing & CapEx Optimization
- Asset & Category Strategy: Architect and execute comprehensive sourcing strategies for high-capital categories, including long-term warehouse leases, general contractors for facility build-outs, Material Handling Equipment (MHE/Automation), and contingent workforce ecosystems.
- Market Intelligence & Financial Modeling: Conduct in-depth market analysis and build sophisticated financial models (TCO, ROI, NPV) to evaluate investment scenarios, driving data-driven asset selection and resource allocation across the US network.
- End-to-End Deal Structuring: Manage the full lifecycle of complex RFI/RFP/RFQ processes. Transition from identifying requirements to stress-testing supplier capabilities and structuring commercially viable deals.
2. Complex Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management
- High-Stakes Negotiation: Manage commercial and contractual negotiations for high-value, multi-year agreements. Focus on securing favorable terms related to pricing, agility (e.g., expansion/termination clauses), service levels, and structural risk mitigation.
- Legal & Commercial Partnership: Partner closely with internal Legal counsel to draft, review, and finalize complex contracts, particularly in commercial real estate (BTS/Leasing), construction, and enterprise staffing.
- Lifecycle Governance: Establish a robust contract lifecycle management (CLM) framework, driving compliance, executing change orders, and capturing value through strategic renewals.
3. Strategic Vendor Ecosystem & Performance Management
- Partnership Ecosystem: Serve as the primary commercial owner for strategic infrastructure partners, cultivating executive-level, collaborative relationships.
- Governance & Continuous Improvement: Implement a rigorous supplier governance framework. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to monitor performance, address operational bottlenecks, and identify opportunities for structural cost reduction.
- Risk Mitigation: Proactively manage multi-dimensional supplier risks, ensuring strict adherence to contractual obligations, insurance mandates, and rigorous safety (EHS) standards.
4. Cross-Functional Management & Business Partnering
- Influence Without Authority: Act as the "commercial CEO" of your infrastructure portfolio. Work hand-in-hand with Real Estate, Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Legal to drive alignment on multi-million dollar project timelines, budgets, and technical specifications.
- Strategic Advisory: Serve as a trusted business partner, providing executive leadership with commercial expertise and market intelligence to guide strategic decisions on network expansion and operational design.
job_post_list.requirement:
Minimum Qualification(s)
- Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a MBA degree. 
- Experience: 3+ years of solid pre-MBA experience in Management Consulting, Corporate Strategy, Real Estate Finance, Commercial Procurement, or Supply Chain Infrastructure.
- Commercial & Financial Acumen: Exceptional capability in building financial models and cost analysis trackers. Proven track record in structuring and managing high-value deals or complex capital projects.
- Strategic Negotiation: Mastery in articulating value propositions and executing high-stakes negotiations across diverse categories (e.g., Real Estate, Construction, Equipment).

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Bias for Action & Ambiguity Navigation: A self-starter with a "builder" mindset. You excel at taking ambiguous business goals, framing a clear commercial strategy, and diving deep to ensure flawless execution.
- Executive Communication: Sophisticated presentation and verbal/written communication skills. Ability to influence leadership and align diverse cross-functional teams.
